name: Lilliel
source: [spoiler]Lilliel is the sole surviving Angel created by Nerose Satanel. Originally one of four Seraphim, the highest rank of Angel, together with her sisters Uriel, Michael, and Raphael, Lilliel, served Satanael and were created as part of Project Paradise Lost.[/spoiler]
translation: [spoiler]Lilliel is the sole surviving Angel created by Nerose Satanel. Originally one of four Seraphim, the highest rank of Angel, together with her sisters Uriel, Michael, and Raphael, Lilliel, served Satanael and were created as part of Project Paradise Lost.[/spoiler]
